# Q-050 E23: a position written where it is not read, as the split an
# invoice's payment block settles from.
#
# A position is read only as `cost_basis_split_guid:` on a split of a
# transaction. Anywhere else an unquoted `$…$` is a variable this format does
# not read there, and the file is refused before any of it is applied, saying
# where a position is read. Onto
# accounts_for_spending_currency_its_own_import_brings_in.txt.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_split_draws_on_a_cost_basis_by_its_position_in_the_file.py.
2026-08-13 * "Received money"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Chequing 500.00 CAD
	Income:Sales -500.00 CAD

customer "C-CAD"
	name: "A Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CAD-1"
	customer_id: "C-CAD"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-08-13
	entry:
		date: 2026-08-13
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 500
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	payment:
		date: 2026-08-13
		txn_split_guid: $transactions_to_import[0].splits[0].guid$
